A copper alloy Roman headstud brooch. The foot of the brooch has a shallowly inscribed transverse groove, above this are three further transverse grooves. The main bow is then decorated with a diamond lattice pattern up to the stud, which consists of a central cup surrounded by a circular groove. There are traces of blue enamel remaining in the diamonds on the bow, and red enamel in the spaces…
